channel.title: Vibe Island Updates
channel.description: Vibe Island - macOS Notch panel for Claude Code

item.title: Version 1.0.43
item.description:
New Features

  • Usage now tracks Fable's own weekly limit with its own reset time, separate from your regular 5-hour and 7-day windows
  • Usage now covers Grok, Cursor, Kimi, MiniMax, and Antigravity — and Claude Desktop now reports accurate usage too
  • See your Codex reset card inventory in the Usage header — how many you have and the earliest expiry time
  • Added Devin — CLI sessions get full lifecycle, approvals in the Notch, and precise terminal jumps; Desktop Cascade and Local sessions are tracked read-only
  • Added Conductor — cards open the exact workspace and chat you were in, and blocking questions surface right on the card
  • See which model and reasoning effort each agent is actually running — including sub-agents on a different model than their parent
  • Qoder now covers the global CLI, Qoder CN, and QoderWork as separate integrations, with two-way approvals and questions on the global CLI
  • Added Zap terminal support, and Kimi Code now works over SSH Remote
  • When an agent asks a question, you can add your own answer instead of only picking from its options — multi-line, paste-friendly, and your draft survives collapsing the panel
  • Follow-up reminders (off by default) — get pinged once about requests still waiting on you, or about finished work you haven't looked at
  • Added Hebrew with right-to-left layout — Vibe Island is now available in 10 languages

Improvements

  • Clicking a card now switches to the Desktop the window is already on, instead of dragging it over to your current one — Terminal.app, WezTerm, and iTerm2
  • Cursor Agent cards open the exact conversation, not just the Cursor window
  • Paseo cards open the exact agent
  • Warp Preview is now recognized on its own instead of being treated as regular Warp
  • Preview Codex's native plan in Vibe Island, then jump back to Codex to act on it
  • Automatic context compaction stays quiet now; manual compaction confirms once and gets out of the way
  • Follow-up reminders understand what you've already read in Codex Desktop
  • Session cards get a Show Tasks toggle — hide the task checklist when you don't need it
  • Make expanded text bigger (up to 16pt) and hover-to-expand less eager (up to 0.8s) — both adjustable in Settings
  • Reopen the current version's release notes anytime from Settings > About
  • SSH Remote now works with Codex installs outside the default location

Fixes

  • Fixed terminal tab titles being overwritten — now only Ghostty gets a minimal title for precise jumps, and even that can be turned off
  • Show Subagents now covers every kind of sub-agent — Agent Teams, Codex and OpenCode child sessions included
  • Fixed background sub-agents never appearing on session cards, and finished ones lingering forever
  • Agent Team teammates now group under their root session instead of scattering as separate cards, and finishing teammates no longer pull up the panel or play sounds
  • Fixed Usage sub-options not appearing until you switched settings tabs and came back
  • Fixed Claude Desktop Rewind leaving two cards for the same conversation
  • Fixed Codex sub-agents inflating the session count, and approvals that arrived before their parent became unreachable
  • Fixed AirPods being taken over even with sound turned off
  • Fixed Plan Review showing an unrelated plan from another session

item.title: Version 1.0.42
item.description:
New Features

  • Added Superset terminal support: session cards jump precisely to the right workspace and terminal
  • SSH Remote: new manual connection mode for hosts that use browser-based or enterprise SSO sign-in
  • Added 4 new languages: Russian, Traditional Chinese, German, and Brazilian Portuguese — Vibe Island is now available in 9 languages

Improvements

  • Orca jump support now truly sticks — jumps self-heal when agent panes are recreated, instead of falling back to just activating the app
  • SSH Remote reliability: isolated remote ports per host entry, clearer trust status for remote Codex hooks, and no more false "update hooks" prompts
  • Plan review now offers Auto Mode, matching Claude Code's current permission modes

Fixes

  • Fixed plan approvals in Claude Code changing your permission mode after review
  • Fixed dismissed question prompts lingering on session cards
  • Fixed thread jumps to Codex Desktop for SSH remote sessions
  • More accurate approval routing for Codex sessions

item.title: Version 1.0.41
item.description:
New Features

  • Added support for the Grok Build CLI — xAI's terminal agent now shows up on the island with live status, its questions, and completion alerts
  • Added support for Orca — jump straight to the right agent's pane inside Stably's agent IDE, even across parallel worktrees
  • Added precise jump support for herdr — click a notification and land on the exact agent pane across its tabs and workspaces (tmux for AI agents)
  • New Quiet scenes — automatically stay silent while a Focus mode is on, your screen is locked, or you're recording or sharing your screen
  • Manage your activated Macs right in the app — see every device and deactivate ones you no longer use
  • New setting to show or hide the project name on session cards

Improvements

  • More reliable subagent lifecycle and status across agents — Claude, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Pi and more
  • Antigravity now surfaces when an agent needs your attention
  • More precise window and tab jumping for WezTerm, Ghostty + tmux, and Otty
  • Codex usage now follows upstream partial rate-limit windows
  • Better hook detection and completion signals for DeepSeek and CodeWhale
  • More reliable Hermes handling across multiple sessions

Fixes

  • Session cards reliably reappear after an app restart
  • Fixed the Settings menu opening a blank window
  • SSH Remote: fixed a reconnect loop that could lock up your Mac
  • Cursor: fixed duplicate and ghost subagent sessions
  • Fixed approval cards getting lost during parallel subagent runs
  • Fixed a duplicate session after using Rewind in Claude Desktop

item.title: Version 1.0.40
item.description:

  • Added support for the Supacode terminal

Improvements

  • Session titles now show your actual prompt instead of injected agent prefixes

  • More reliable OpenCode session tracking — no more duplicate or stuck-busy sessions
  • Built-in Silence filters are now shown as clearer presets
  • Better approval handling for ZCode and MiMoCode

  • More accurate Codex status with quieter background prompts
  • Improved terminal jump accuracy across Ghostty, Zed, Supacode, and more

Fixes

  • Codex Auto Review is now always handled silently and no longer interrupts you with approval cards
  • Fixed OpenCode showing repeated completion notifications during tool-heavy turns
  • Fixed "Always allow" not being selectable for ZCode approvals
  • Fixed a false "script not found" warning for status line scripts that use $HOME
  • Fixed status line setup that could overwrite custom configurations
  • Kimi Code sessions are no longer removed by mistake during interactive use

  • Fixed hook setup for Claude Code custom config paths
  • Improved overall stability and reliability

item.title: Version 1.0.39
item.description:
New Features

  • New agent integrations: Oh My Pi, ZCode (ZhipuAI), Trae, MiMoCode, Kimi Code, and Mistral Vibe
  • Session cards now show a Git worktree / branch indicator
  • Optional AI model name on session cards (off by default)
  • New Glance completion mode — when a task finishes, the panel can stay collapsed with a subtle green dot instead of auto-expanding
  • Subagent display controls for cleaner fan-out panels
  • Precise jump for VS Code's native Claude extension — click a notification to land on the exact terminal tab
  • Precise jump for remote Codex App sessions over SSH — clicking a notification takes you straight to the right thread (Remote Codex App sessions only)

Improvements

  • SSH Remote now automatically reconnects after network changes or sleep, and supports passphrase-protected keys
  • When you're already viewing a conversation in your IDE, Vibe Island no longer shows a duplicate completion notification for it
  • Codex Auto Approve (auto-review) requests are now correctly detected and filtered, so they're no longer intercepted
  • Simplified Codex approval settings (Approve here / Remind me / Hide)
  • License recovery screen for seat-limit and activation issues
  • Shows elapsed time while compacting
  • Localization and overall performance improvements

Fixes

  • Fixed completion cards not showing in VS Code / Cursor native extension sessions
  • Improved CLI plugin detection and overall stability

item.title: Version 1.0.34
item.description:
New Features

  • Antigravity CLI support
  • Tencent WorkBuddy support
  • Update Control redesign. Pick between Notify me, manual checks, or automatic install. The pill reads "Update" when one is available
  • AskUserQuestion wizard handles multi-question prompts with pagination and keyboard shortcuts
  • Codex usage limit detection. The panel now shows when you've hit your quota
  • One switch to toggle every global keyboard shortcut off; reverse mode if you keep colliding with the default keys
  • Silence Rules match by prompt text or by which app launched the CLI
  • Zellij pane jump support

Improvements

  • Warp jumps land on the right tab and pane even after the binding moves between windows
  • VS Code and Cursor windows focus faster on jump
  • DeepSeek TUI approval prompts show up in the notch panel
  • Codex hook trust banner is dismissible. When trust fails it points you at /hooks instead of looping retries
  • Cursor subagent workers embed under their parent session
  • OpenCode subagent sessions nest correctly under the parent task
  • Codex Desktop reveals are now per-thread aware. Viewing thread A no longer hides a completion or warning from thread B
  • Hermes plugin install and detection respect the active profile

Fixes

  • Cleared leftover status warnings and recap text that could linger from a previous turn
  • Terminal title writes work under Claude Code 2.1.139+ CTTY isolation
  • Copilot CLI permission and question prompts survive tool-cleanup events

item.title: Version 1.0.33
item.description:
New Features

  • Session recap — Claude Code's away-summary surfaces directly on idle session cards
  • DeepSeek CLI integration — turn detection and completion notifications via TUI hooks
  • Pi extension integration — Pi joins the supported agent lineup with managed extension auto-install
  • Kimi coding plan auto-detection — when Claude Code is routed through a Kimi Anthropic-compatible endpoint, usage now shows Kimi quota automatically
  • Cursor external-approval hint — when Cursor is waiting on its own Ask-Every-Time or network-command approval, Notch highlights the session with a "Continue in Cursor" cue
  • Silence rules: first-prompt filters — mute sessions by matching the initial prompt text in addition to title / CLI / tool
  • Codex hook trust authorization — one-tap authorize Vibe Island hooks when Codex 0.129+ marks them as untrusted

Improvements

  • Cursor 3.4.1 (Auto-Run Mode) compatibility — fully aligned with the renamed YOLO/allowlist semantics
  • OpenCode Desktop fully restored — monitoring, approvals, question replies, and event bridge all working again after the v1.14.37+ Electron migration
  • SSH remote stability — faster tunnel reconnect after drops, support for ProxyJump / ProxyCommand / -F config, fish-shell-friendly pre-clean, quoted-option parsing
  • Usage panel reliability — unified reset-time parsing across statusline cache and OAuth schemas, expired countdowns auto-hide, OAuth refresh cooldown tightened 5min → 2min
  • z.ai weekly quota — correctly decoded and per-provider refresh cadence independent of others
  • VS Code / Cursor jumping — installed extensions reconciled across forks so jumps land on the right window
  • Qwen Code, Warp — hook toggle refresh, foreground-only active-pane lookup

Fixes

  • Cursor allowlist regression where allowlist mode was incorrectly treated as YOLO mode
  • SSH port collision guard against killing foreign processes holding the same port
  • OpenCode plugin port discovery now rejects non-OpenCode local servers
  • Always-allow approvals on OpenCode

item.title: Version 1.0.32
item.description:
Highlights

  • Fixes for two issues introduced in v1.0.31 — usage data refresh stalls for users running both Claude and Codex, and multi-window jumping opening the wrong VS Code window

New Features

  • Custom silence rules — define your own filters to mute noisy sessions, with hidden-directory smart suggestions and live match preview
  • Customizable collapse-panel shortcut — record any key combo in Settings
  • Idle reminder toggle — separate sound control, independent from approval and notification sounds
  • Panel size customization — new width slider (440–800pt), expanded height ranges, with live preview while dragging
  • Multi-window jumping for VS Code and Cursor — accurately opens the correct window when several are running
  • SSH remote improvements — hook config drift auto-detection prompts re-setup, friendlier error messages, actionable update notices

Improvements

  • Better audio quality on AirPods and high-rate output devices — fixed 24 kHz aliasing
  • Settings window rebuilt — Mission Control, Space switching, and update dialogs now behave correctly
  • Notch alignment improved across all MacBook models, with a tuning slider for edge cases
  • Subagent and Agent Team filtering — properly silenced across sounds, panel expansion and notifications, with self-healing for stuck pending states
  • Bypass mode pill redesigned as a capsule for visual consistency
  • Diff line numbers wrap correctly for 4-digit values
  • Accurate Usage tracking — Claude Code, Kimi and Codex plan data refreshes more reliably with improved diagnostics

Fixes

  • Pinned Codex usage refresh
  • AskUserQuestion preserves question text during bypass mode
  • VS Code Extension sessions no longer prematurely cleaned at 5 minutes
  • Bare letter shortcuts no longer collide with disabled bindings
  • SSH tunnel surfaces real connection errors instead of fake "connected" state
  • Z.ai legacy quota windows now display correctly
  • Enterprise plan usage windows no longer falsely show 0%
  • Agent Team mode now correctly mutes child agent sounds when enabled
  • Gemini hook installation status correctly detected (no more false ✓)
